name: Neynar
description: The dominant commercial API for Farcaster social data — feeds, casts, users, social graph, notifications, and webhooks. Abstracts direct Farcaster Hub access behind a reliable, rate-limited REST and SDK interface.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The default Farcaster data layer. Appears in the majority of production Farcaster miniapps and social apps.
Relevant only when Base apps have Farcaster social features.

common_pairings.context: Neynar provides the Farcaster social context (FID, custody address, social graph); Privy creates the embedded wallet for that Farcaster user.
Neynar for Farcaster social data and cast operations; OnchainKit for the Base-native UI components and frame rendering.
Neynar handles social data reads and writes (casts, reactions, follows); Farcaster Frames SDK handles frame rendering and message validation.
Neynar webhooks trigger AI agent logic; Neynar cast APIs allow agents to post replies. The canonical Farcaster social AI agent pairing.
Neynar webhooks deliver Farcaster events; Trigger.dev provides durable execution for the agent logic triggered by those webhooks.
Neynar for Farcaster social layer; Alchemy for Base chain data. Used together in Farcaster miniapps that interact with Base.

trust_evidence.description: Neynar is the dominant commercial Farcaster API. Appears in the majority of production Farcaster miniapps and social applications.
Neynar + Privy + Base is the most consistently cited Farcaster miniapp production stack across WORKFLOWS.md and corpus analysis.
Neynar maintains an active @neynar/nodejs-sdk with typed APIs, webhook infrastructure, and comprehensive Farcaster protocol coverage.
Integrated by or paired with: Privy, OnchainKit, Vercel AI SDK, Trigger.dev — high integration density across Farcaster production stacks.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use the free tier API key. Neynar free tier is sufficient for development and hackathon use.
scale_guidance.mvp: Paid tier required for production. Set up cost monitoring early — Neynar pricing scales with API requests.
scale_guidance.production: Plan Neynar tier based on DAU and social action frequency. At very high scale (>100k DAU), evaluate direct Farcaster Hub access for the highest-volume queries while keeping Neynar for lower-volume features.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When Neynar pricing becomes unsustainable at high volume. Direct Hub access requires operating your own Farcaster Hub node or using a free hub endpoint. Significant operational complexity tradeoff.

anti_patterns: Building Farcaster apps without Neynar at MVP scale — direct Hub access is operationally complex and not worth it until Neynar pricing is a confirmed bottleneck.
Using Neynar for non-Farcaster social data — Neynar is Farcaster-specific.
Not setting up Neynar webhooks for event-driven apps — polling Neynar APIs instead of using webhooks adds latency and wastes API quota.
